questions.title: Org Chart Depth
questions.description:
The depth of an org chart decides how many approval layers a request crosses. Height counts the nodes on the longest chain of command; an empty chart has height 0. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int height(TNode root)

It must return the height of the org chart (0 for an empty chart).

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of slots in the level-order description. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the org chart in level order, -1 marks a missing child.

Output Format:
One line with the height.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 2000, -1 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Preorder Traversal
questions.description:
A preorder walk records the root first, then the whole left subtree, then the whole right subtree — the natural order for copying a tree. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void preorder(TNode root, ArrayList<Integer> out)

It must append the node values in preorder into out (the harness prints them space-separated).

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of slots in the level-order description. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the tree in level order, -1 marks a missing child.

Output Format:
One line with the preorder values space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 2000, -1 <= value <= 1000, the tree is non-empty

questions.title: Backbone Path Length
questions.description:
A campus network hangs its buildings off a binary tree; the backbone is the longest path between any two buildings, measured in edges. A useful fact: for each node, the longest path through it joins the deepest ends of its two subtrees. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int diameter(TNode root)

It must return the number of edges on the longest path between any two nodes (0 for an empty tree or a single node).

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of slots in the level-order description. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the network tree in level order, -1 marks a missing child.

Output Format:
One line with the backbone length in edges.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 2000, -1 <= value <= 1000
